build.profile: a 49 mm body tube, a step to the 62 mm foam head at about 118 mm and a domed foam top; the yoke, the rear switch cover and the cover plate are not modelled (revolve cannot build them). No product photo was opened for this device, so the silhouette is a plausible lathe profile drawn from the published length and widest diameter, NOT measured from a photo or drawing: the size is exact, the shape between the stations is an estimate (confidence guess). The Shure guide drawing prints 48 mm and 63.5 mm, which are not mapped to a part here.
